repo_meta_data.description: MindSQL: A Python Text-to-SQL RAG Library simplifying database interactions. Seamlessly integrates with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Snowflake, and BigQuery. Powered by GPT-4 and Llama 2, it enables natural language queries. Supports ChromaDB and Faiss for context-aware responses.
